05

Better together

THE CREW

Alone you explore.
Together you belong.

A week of
good company.

This week wasn't about one big event. It was about the people. Kayaking down the river, shooting hoops on the court, and a hundred small moments in between — none of it would have meant anything alone.

On the water, a kayak only goes straight if everyone paddles in sync. On the court, the best shot is the one you pass. Funny how the activities kept teaching us the same lesson: we're better together.

We arrived in Amarante as strangers from different countries. Five weeks in, we finish each other's jokes, share every meal, and never have to ask twice for someone to come along. That's the part we'll miss the most.

The city, the river, the courts, they're just the backdrop. The crew is the story.
